# dsh-plugin-cc > Claude Code 命令插件通过本地 bridge 委派 DSH 任务，支持结果保存及临时多轮。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc](https://github.com/cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc) - **版本号**：2.0.2（[固定提交 ffa8e8599d45582b1c73062cefcb9fcd40c69a72](https://github.com/cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc/tree/ffa8e8599d45582b1c73062cefcb9fcd40c69a72)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-25（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核对权限 overlay 和 broker 生命周期，未执行。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：Claude Code 用户需要在当前仓库调用 DSH 审阅或执行任务。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 命令化委派并提供结果管理。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 等待超时仍执行，停止会丢失内存会话。 - **建议**：[Q03](#research-q03) 对照手工入口测切换和恢复成本。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 先只读任务，再演练超时停止。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 命令化委派并提供结果管理。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 等待超时仍执行，停止会丢失内存会话。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q03](#research-q03) 对照手工入口测切换和恢复成本。 同任务对照、超时查询和进程树终止。 ## 场景与替代办法 Claude Code 用户需要在当前仓库调用 DSH 审阅或执行任务。 手工复制任务到 DSH 终端并保存结果。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Claude Code、POSIX、DSH | 必需 | 挂载命令和运行任务 | Windows 未支持 | | Node 与模型密钥 | 必需 | 启动和模型调用 | 版本需核对 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 在测试仓库做 setup | 确认 pin | | 委派 | 只读 review 后核对结果 | 查看存活任务 | | 收尾 | 确认进程和结果 | 多轮停止会丢状态 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 资源未知 | 安装 pin 和 profile | 核对工具模式 | | 持续 | token 未知 | 审阅输出并监控进程 | 多轮占资源 | | 失败 | 工时未知 | 查询状态再决定停止 | 不要盲重试 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 跨代理委派 | 同一命令取结果 | 实际准确率与节时 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：Claude Code 用户能否便捷委派 DSH 任务并明确多轮存活边界？ ### Q01 · Claude 用户如何把任务交给 DSH？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 Claude Code 插件命令通过 bridge 启动 DSH，提供审阅、一次任务、后台委派和 broker 多轮。默认 standard 使用完整工具表，minimal 则固定两个工具。相对手动复制到终端，命令保存结果并可查看；它本身安装到 Claude Code，DSH 是外部运行时。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:9-29](https://github.com/cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc/blob/ffa8e8599d45582b1c73062cefcb9fcd40c69a72/README.md#L9-L29) 产品入口及模式。
查看原文（21行） ```text Claude Code plugin that runs **DeepSeek Harness** (`dsh`) from slash commands: review, critique, one-shot tasks, and resumable multi-turn sessions. Pin: [`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh). After upgrading the plugin, rerun `/dsh:setup`. Re-verify [docs/dsh-compat.md](docs/dsh-compat.md) on every dsh upgrade. ## Agent modes Default is **`standard`**. `minimal` and `anchored-standard` are switches — they are not the default. | Mode | Tools the model sees | |---|---| | **`standard`** (default) | Full dsh-base catalog from request #1 (search, skills, subagents, …). No overlay. | | `minimal` | bash + `str_replace_editor` for the **whole** run. Extra tools cannot appear later. | | `anchored-standard` | Those two tools first. After this session records a tool call **or** an assistant reply, the next assemble restores the full catalog. | Switch: - this run: `/dsh:run --mode minimal …` or `--mode anchored-standard` - this shell: `DSH_CC_MODE=minimal` - this machine: `/dsh:setup --mode minimal` A broker (`--session` / `--resume` / `/dsh:import`) keeps the mode it started with. Mismatch → `/dsh:stop --broker`. ```
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:44-70](https://github.com/cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc/blob/ffa8e8599d45582b1c73062cefcb9fcd40c69a72/README.md#L44-L70) 命令与 bridge。
查看原文（27行） ```text ## Commands | Command | What it does | |---|---| | `/dsh:check` | Readiness probe | | `/dsh:setup` | Install pinned npm CLI (or `--harness`) and the multi-turn `cc` profile | | `/dsh:review [focus]` | Read-only review of local changes | | `/dsh:critique [focus]` | Structured adversarial critique | | `/dsh:run ` | Task (`--write`, `--session`, `--resume`, `--mode`, `--background`) | | `/dsh:delegate ` | Background handoff via the `dsh-delegate` subagent | | `/dsh:import` | Weak-import this conversation into a resumable dsh session | | `/dsh:runs` / `/dsh:show` | List runs / replay a stored result | | `/dsh:stop` / `--broker` | Kill a run / the shared broker | Flags and failure modes: [docs/commands.md](docs/commands.md). Recovery: [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md). ## For agents Read in this order; stop when you can act. 1. This README (modes + commands) 2. [docs/commands.md](docs/commands.md) — flags 3. [plugins/dsh/skills/dsh-delegate-runtime/SKILL.md](plugins/dsh/skills/dsh-delegate-runtime/SKILL.md) — how to invoke the bridge 4. [docs/dsh-compat.md](docs/dsh-compat.md) — DSH pin; re-verify on upgrade 5. [NOTICE](NOTICE) — third-party licenses (do not restate) Entry: `plugins/dsh/scripts/dsh-bridge.mjs` (one subcommand per capability; stdout is user-facing). DSH argv and overlays: `plugins/dsh/scripts/lib/dsh.mjs`. Broker: `plugins/dsh/scripts/dsh-broker.mjs` — started by the bridge; **never start it by hand**. Tests: `npm test` (fake dsh, no API key). ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/scripts/lib/dsh.mjs:485-519](https://github.com/cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc/blob/ffa8e8599d45582b1c73062cefcb9fcd40c69a72/plugins/dsh/scripts/lib/dsh.mjs#L485-L519) 启动 overlay 固定权限。
查看原文（35行） ```text * - approval `never`: nobody is present to answer prompts; the sandbox mode * stays the real safety boundary. * - a `permission` row whose single `unattended` preset matches exactly * (mode, never): dsh-base's permission-presets service refuses to boot * when the composed sandbox+approval pair names no preset, and it PINS the * default preset's knobs into fresh sessions — so the preset must mirror * the launch mode or it would override DSH_PERMISSION_MODE. */ export function buildUnattendedOverlayYaml(permissionMode) { const mode = normalizePermissionMode(permissionMode) ?? "read-only"; return [ "# generated by dsh-plugin-cc (unattended composition; see lib/dsh.mjs)", "- id: approval", " config:", " policy: never", "- id: permission", " config:", " presets:", " unattended:", ` sandbox: ${yamlQuote(mode)}`, " approval: never", " name: unattended", ` description: ${yamlQuote("dsh-plugin-cc unattended run: sandbox fixed at launch, approvals disabled.")}`, " defaultPreset: unattended", "" ].join("\n"); } /** Write the per-mode unattended overlay under `/overlays`; returns its path. */ export function writeUnattendedOverlay(dir, permissionMode) { const mode = normalizePermissionMode(permissionMode) ?? "read-only"; const overlaysDir = path.join(dir, "overlays"); fs.mkdirSync(overlaysDir, { recursive: true }); const file = path.join(overlaysDir, `unattended-${mode}.yml`); fs.writeFileSync(file, buildUnattendedOverlayYaml(mode), "utf8"); ```
#### 缺口 - 真实跨产品交接未运行 **影响**：不知道审阅和委派成功率 **进一步探讨**：在测试仓库对照复制与 slash 命令 ### Q02 · 超时和停止会怎样影响多轮？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 broker 在每工作区提供 Unix socket，超时回报错误但运行时继续工作。停止 broker 通过终止进程放弃全部内存会话，不能推断任务收到超时就停止。默认只读，写权限在启动前确定，中途无人可审批。对话导入为文本摘要，图片和原生历史不保留。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[plugins/dsh/scripts/dsh-broker.mjs:227-238](https://github.com/cpj-dev/dsh-plugin-cc/blob/ffa8e8599d45582b1c73062cefcb9fcd40c69a72/plugins/dsh/scripts/dsh-broker.mjs#L227-L238) 等待超时仍执行。
